rounds.text: Zenith Exports Ltd trades at a highly attractive price-to-book ratio of just 1.28x against a book value of ₹ 156 per share on a price of ₹ 199 [E2], which is even more compelling when compared to a sector benchmark P/B of 2.06x [E7]. Furthermore, the company commands a modest market capitalisation of ₹ 110 Cr [E3], leaving room for fundamental outperformance as profit growth recently exceeds one-year price growth by 177%, signaling that the company is starting to outperform expectations [E55]. Operational momentum is also visible with sales up quarter-over-quarter [E66], and compounded sales growth over the last five years has achieved a positive 5% [E15]. Conceded: the trailing twelve months show compounded sales growth at -18% [E17], the 10-year compounded sales growth sits at -12% [E14], and the stock trades at an elevated P/E of 381x [E1].
